history.summary: A very large 1,539 sqft 99LH 3BR at $1,222 psf, ~10% under the $1,352 district median, in a 720-unit Bedok Reservoir development backing onto the reservoir. URA resale CAGR is a strong 7.3%/yr over 129 txns, but the 2000-vintage estate carries real management, leak and noise complaints that temper the value case.
history.rating_rationale: The numbers are attractive — $1,222 psf vs $1,352 median, 7.3%/yr resale CAGR over 129 txns, a huge 1,539 sqft layout under $1.9M, and reservoir-fronting amenity. But qualitative findings are a genuine drag: residents report poor MCST management, recurring unit leaks (especially upper units), evening noise, and it being the oldest/most run-down condo in the Bedok Reservoir cluster. With Bedok Reservoir MRT a 10-min/820m walk and 26-year lease decay (~74yr remaining), the appreciation may already reflect a low base catching up rather than durable quality. Mixed signals net to Neutral.
red_flags: Reported poor MCST management, lax bylaw enforcement and resident disharmony
Recurring water-leak complaints (notably upper-floor/penthouse units) and evening noise from pool/playground
Oldest, most dated development in the Bedok Reservoir cluster; 820m to MRT; ~74yr lease remaining
catalysts: Bedok Reservoir frontage and Downtown Line access (DT30) underpin lifestyle and rental demand
Large 1,539 sqft layout at sub-$1.9M is rare value for space-driven families
7.3%/yr resale CAGR shows the low base has been converging toward the cluster

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Reservoir lifestyle and DTL access give steady but unspectacular family-tenant demand; dated facilities and management issues cap achievable rent versus newer Bedok Reservoir stock.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Headline 7.3%/yr CAGR is partly low-base catch-up; quality and management drag plus lease decay make a repeat over the next 5-7yr uncertain. Expect moderation toward district average.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: URA resale 7.3%/yr discounted heavily for management/quality drag and lease decay
